dockerfile:
FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qbittorrent-nox ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN useradd -m qbuser && mkdir -p /config /downloads && chown -R qbuser /config /downloads
USER qbuser
ENV WEBUI_PORT=8080 TZ=Asia/Shanghai
VOLUME /config /downloads
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["sh","-c","exec qbittorrent-nox --webui-port=${WEBUI_PORT:-8080}"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends valkey-server ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN mkdir -p /data && chown -R valkey:valkey /data
USER valkey
ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai
VOLUME /data
EXPOSE 6379
ENTRYPOINT ["sh","-c","exec valkey-server --bind 0.0.0.0 --dir /data --save 60 1 --appendonly no"]

FROM lcr.loongnix.cn/library/debian:sid-20250615
RUN printf 'Types: deb\nURIs: http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/debian\nSuites: sid\nComponents: main\nSigned-By: /usr/share/keyrings/debian-archive-keyring.gpg\n' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources && rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends zabbix-agent && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY entry.sh /entry.sh
RUN chmod +x /entry.sh
EXPOSE 10050
ENTRYPOINT ["/entry.sh"]
